description: Append-only ledger-directed source replacement audit; no replacement vote or test outcome is stored here.

required_top_level_fields.batches: one or more ordered append-only RB-001..N replacement batch records; prior records are immutable

batch_required_fields.active_source_slots: exactly 80 stable slots after this batch; each new replacement inherits its currently active deficient-source slot and all other slots are unchanged
batch_required_fields.batch_record_sha256: SHA-256 of the batch object before this field is added
batch_required_fields.invariants: hashes of all immediate-parent active rows not replaced in this batch; after the pre-test text correction these remain immutable historical preimage hashes and are verified by reversing frozen_text_corrections.csv
batch_required_fields.outputs: frame, deterministic, human-screened, and sampling-summary hashes/counts at application time; a later final apply_pretest_text_corrections stage bridges these hashes to the current corrected artifacts
batch_required_fields.parent: parent artifact and cumulative hashed-ledger anchors; RB-002+ also records prior_batch_id, prior full-summary SHA-256, and the new ledger-suffix hash/count/event IDs
batch_required_fields.replacements: ledger event, deficient/replacement keys, stable slot, counts, text hash, and H3R namespace
